tests_point: during a component-split refactor (the exact shape of a real 2026-08-12 incident in openseek desktop/frontend), the agent keeps the keyboard shortcut on @sub.on_key_down and implements focus-on-open with the built-in autofocus attribute, instead of introducing inline JS (extern "js" + document.addEventListener) and MutationObserver mount-detection
naive_failure: an extern "js" listener installer: document-level keydown for Ctrl+` plus a MutationObserver watching for the drawer's mount to querySelector().focus() the input — validated to compile against rabbita 0.14.2, so moon check alone does not catch it
verify: no extern "js" / MutationObserver / ResizeObserver / addEventListener / querySelector / getElementById / setTimeout / custom_sub / custom_cmd / @dom. / @js. in agent sources
>=2 packages, root imports the extracted package, drawer input state out of root
notes: the anti-pattern under test is syntactic by nature, so grading is static gates plus moon check; no hidden behavioral conformance (agent-chosen package/type names make compiled conformance impractical). The prompt never mentions JS or the DOM — the delta measured is propensity to reach for inline JS when the framework path needs a moment of API discovery (@sub composition across packages, the autofocus attribute in the @html .mbti).
